description: This file defines a PHP class HTMLPurifier_VarParser that parses string representations into corresponding PHP native variable types. It includes type constants, type validation methods, and error handling for variable parsing.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_VarParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing string representations into native PHP variable types with validation and error handling.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Validates and coerces a variable to the specified type, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: parseImplementation
methods.description: Base method meant to be overridden to implement specific parsing logic; default implementation returns the input unaltered.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws an HTMLPurifier_VarParserException with a custom message.

methods.name: errorInconsistent
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating an inconsistency during parsing or type handling.

methods.name: errorGeneric
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating a type mismatch during validation.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string name for a given type constant.
